en.heroTitle: Reliable LED power supply manufacturing for global projects.
en.heroText: Guangdong Huapu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. builds HPMN / HPMN Power constant voltage switching power supplies for LED lighting, signage, cabinet lighting, and project-based applications.
en.aboutTitle: Guangdong Huapu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
en.aboutText1: HPMN Power specializes in the R&D and manufacturing of constant voltage switching power supplies for LED applications.
en.aboutText2: Products are widely used in LED lighting, advertising signage, channel letters, outdoor lighting projects, commercial displays and interior decoration projects. We focus on product quality, reliability and long-term cooperation, providing efficient manufacturing, fast technical support and flexible customization for global distributors, OEM partners and project customers.
en.whyTitle: Built for LED power supply buyers, distributors, and OEM partners.
en.value1Text: Reliable constant voltage switching power supplies for LED lighting, signage, industrial and commercial applications.
en.value2Text: Custom branding, housing, packaging and electrical specifications available for global partners.
en.value3Text: Supporting distributors, wholesalers, contractors and OEM customers worldwide.
en.value4Text: Three-stage testing process: preliminary test, ATE integrated test, and aging test.
en.value5Text: Stock-based sales model with sufficient inventory capacity to support distributors, project orders and repeat purchasing needs.
en.value6Text: Responsive pre-sales and after-sales communication for model selection, project requirements and OEM customization.
en.mfgTitle: Testing, manufacturing, warehousing, and automated potting capability.
en.mfgText: HPMN promotes modern manufacturing with ATE testing, aging cabinets, controlled production areas, automated potting equipment, and warehouse-based stock support for responsive lead times.
en.productsTitle: Constant voltage switching power supplies for LED projects.
en.productsText: Categories and product cards are generated from the current HPMN material library and can be expanded when new files are added.
en.downloadsText: Only HPMN product manuals are listed here for overseas customers.
en.contactTitle: Discuss your power supply requirement with HPMN.
en.contactText: Send your product category, required voltage/current, quantity, destination market, and application needs. The HPMN team can prepare a suitable recommendation.

zh.heroTitle: 面向全球项目的 LED 电源制造能力。
zh.heroText: 广东华普智能科技有限公司生产 HPMN / HPMN Power 恒压开关电源，应用于 LED 照明、标识亮化、橱柜灯和工程项目。
zh.aboutTitle: 广东华普智能科技有限公司
zh.aboutText1: HPMN Power 是一家专业从事 LED 应用恒压开关电源研发与制造的企业。
zh.aboutText2: 产品广泛应用于 LED 照明、广告标识、发光字、户外亮化工程、商业展示以及室内装饰项目。我们专注于产品质量、可靠性和长期合作，为全球经销商、OEM 合作伙伴及工程项目客户提供高效制造、快速技术支持和灵活定制服务。
zh.whyTitle: 为 LED 电源采购商、经销商和 OEM 合作伙伴打造。
zh.value1Text: 可靠的恒压开关电源，适用于 LED 照明、标识亮化、工业和商业应用。
zh.value2Text: 支持品牌定制、外壳、包装和电气规格定制，服务全球合作伙伴。
zh.value3Text: 支持全球经销商、批发商、工程承包商和 OEM 客户。
zh.value4Text: 三道测试流程：初测、ATE 综合测试和老化测试。
zh.value5Text: 采用仓储式销售模式，具备充足库存与供货能力，支持经销商、工程订单和长期复购需求。
zh.value6Text: 针对选型、工程需求和 OEM 定制提供快速的售前售后沟通支持。
zh.mfgTitle: 测试、制造、仓储与自动灌胶能力。
zh.mfgText: HPMN 配备 ATE 测试、老化柜、受控生产区域、自动灌胶设备和仓储式库存支持，提升交期响应能力。
zh.productsTitle: 面向 LED 项目的恒压开关电源。
zh.productsText: 产品分类和产品卡片基于当前 HPMN 资料库生成，后续新增资料可继续扩展。
zh.downloadsText: 此处仅展示面向海外客户的 HPMN 产品手册。
zh.contactTitle: 与 HPMN 沟通您的电源需求。
zh.contactText: 请提供产品类别、电压/电流、数量、目标市场和应用需求，HPMN 团队可为您推荐合适方案。
